description.fun: Kecleon can change colour at will to blend into its surroundings, sneaking up on prey and snatching it with its long tongue, but it can never change the red zigzag around its middle. If it stays unnoticed for too long, it sulks and may never show itself again. In the Hoenn games, invisible Kecleon block paths until a Devon Scope reveals them.
description.guide: A Normal-type Pokémon based on a chameleon, able to change colour to camouflage itself, and the only Pokémon with the Color Change Ability. It lives in tropical and temperate forests. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A chameleon that can vanish, except for its red zigzag
